units.speaker: Ben
units.text: From a harbor tower to a house of stone heads.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Through an execution square, a church over sixty thousand graves, a hidden courtyard.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: And the spookiest part was true.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: The floor of the Oude Kerk.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: The second round. There are cafes and bars along the Keizersgracht and around the Spui.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: Raise a glass to the maid, if you like.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: To the gods on the wall.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: To the gods on the wall.

units.speaker: Anna
units.text: Safe walk home, everyone. Mind the canal edges.

units.speaker: Ben
units.text: And remember the stamp. Record, or legend.
